events.title: Historic Lewes Farmers Market — Saturday Market
events.description: Weekly Saturday farmers market season running May 2–Sept. 26, 2026.
events.editorialNote: Recurring weekly market, not a single date.

events.title: The Point's Bayside Beach Reopens at Cape Henlopen
events.description: The bayside beach at The Point, held closed through September for migrating shorebirds, reopens to the public. The oceanside beach reopened Sept. 1.
events.editorialNote: DNREC also lists a free guided 1.7-mile hike to The Point on Oct. 1; preregistration is required for the hike.

events.title: Historic Lewes Farmers Market – Fall Saturday Season
events.description: The market shifts to its fall Saturday schedule at the Lewes Elementary School parking lot, running through early December.
events.venue: Lewes Elementary School parking lot, 820 Savannah Rd.
events.editorialNote: Season transition worth flagging so readers don't show up at the summer location.

events.title: Bridgeville Apple-Scrapple Festival
events.description: Bridgeville's signature fall festival weekend, with Thursday carnival night followed by Friday and Saturday food, entertainment, vendors and contests downtown.
events.editorialNote: Thursday is Hometown Carnival Night; the main festival opens Friday at 4 p.m. and Saturday at 9 a.m.

events.title: October Trails Day at Cape Henlopen
events.description: Volunteer-led monthly trail clean-up and restoration day hosted by the Friends of Cape Henlopen State Park.
events.sourceOrg: Friends of Cape Henlopen State Park
events.editorialNote: The calendar confirms date/time; registration, cost and meeting-point details were not published in the source checked.
